timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Containers are isolated, so they're safe, right?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: They share the host kernel. Isolation is earned through configuration, not magic.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Scan them for vulnerabilities, sign and verify them, use minimal base images.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Run non-root, drop unnecessary capabilities, read-only filesystems, resource limits.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: RBAC with least privilege. Nobody is cluster-admin by default.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Managed secret store. Never environment literals in the manifest.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Network policies. Microsegment workloads so one pod can't roam the cluster.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Pod security standards enforce safe defaults cluster-wide.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Encrypted traffic and policy between services. Defense in depth at the seam.
